note: Distant-concept deck. The draw script guarantees that a drawn set spans disjoint top-level categories, so the combination cannot collapse into one familiar field. 'probe' is the question the drawn domain must actually answer inside the result - a domain that is name-dropped but answers nothing is a decoration and must be cut.
